test_title: PYST 51: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**between**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence is referring to a **choice between two items** — coffee and tea.
 
• The correct preposition for making a choice involving **two distinct options** is "**between**".
 
• "Among" is used when referring to **more than two items**, which does not apply here.
 
• "On" and "around" are not suitable in this context, as they do not indicate choice or preference.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *I asked his preference between__ coffee and tea.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Use "**between**" when distinguishing or choosing **between two elements**.
 
• Use "**among**" when the choice or reference involves **more than two** items or people.
